items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I think Andy Paddy LaVerne told me... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I would like to add something to that...

ctx.x: That does evoke some things about -- several people in the band are people who have been on the band, have told me that if it weren't for Frank, in a way, and his way of helping -- for instance, I think Andy Paddy LaVerne told me, he says, "Boy, I'll tell you, if I didn't get the kind of tutelage from -- counsel from Frank Tiberio, I could never not have lasted on the road. But he's done it, and he can help others make it."
Well, I would like to add something to that, which I don't think too many people think about. He had his whole career before he went on the road.
